meta.note: Fern Hollow Preserve is invented, and so is everything on this page. The bundle exists to exercise the format: nested slots, image and non-image assets, props of several shapes.

props.heading: Trail Guide
props.body: Eleven miles of marked trail through the creek bottom and up onto the ridge. Open dawn to dusk, year round, no entry fee.

featured_image.alt: A boardwalk junction in winter woods, with a carved wooden signpost pointing toward the campground, visitor center, and trail

props.heading: Pick a trail
props.body:
All three loops start from the same parking area and are blazed in different colors. Trail conditions change fast after rain — the creek crossing on the Blue Loop is genuinely impassable in spring.

If you have never been here before, start with the Boardwalk Loop.

props.title: Boardwalk Loop
props.body: Half a mile, flat, fully accessible. Elevated boardwalk over the wetland, with benches at both ends.

image.alt: A boardwalk curving away through green swamp forest, with a bench beside it

props.title: Blue Loop
props.body: Three and a half miles along the creek. One unbridged crossing — check the water level before you start.

props.title: Ridge Trail
props.body: Seven miles out and back, with about nine hundred feet of climbing. The overlook is worth it in October.

props.heading: Before you go
props.body: There is no cell service past the first quarter mile. Tell somebody your route, carry water, and turn around with enough daylight to get back.
